'''Shiyu''' is an NPC resonator in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. 

==Profile==
She is first introduced by her sister [[Shixia]] in "The Past is the Future: Introduction" side quest. Unlike her sister, she is born with a gift as a resonator. While her sister lives as a normal [[Jinzhou]] kid, studies hard, gets the best grade, achieves her goals, and gets the best job, Shiyu lives as a resonator and walked a different path. She's already quite skilled and further trained her martial arts. Traveling through [[Huanglong]] is also one of her paths. Now, she became one of the [[Midnight Rangers]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Shiyu:''' I don't recall Liondance Troupe putting on a show for a while. What a pity...
:'''Shiyu:''' Ah, someone's coming.
:{{DIcon}} You want to see the Liondance Troupe's peformance?
::'''Shiyu:''' Yes, yes! Do you also like the Liondance Troupe?
::'''Shiyu:''' My wish is that, one day, I can just get off work, stroll into this theater, and kick back and watch a performance by the Liondance Troupe without distruptions.
::'''Shiyu:''' That would be great! But I have to finish my work first, everyone is still waiting for me!
:{{DIcon}} I'm just passing by.
::'''Shiyu:''' Sure! But perhaps it's better that you don't run around or make a lot of noise.
{{Dialogue End}}
